categories.main_business_segments: Muyuan Foods Co., Ltd. primarily operates in integrated pig farming and pork processing. Its main business segments include pig breeding and farming, slaughtering, and meat product sales. The company has developed a vertically integrated supply chain covering feed production, pig breeding, pig farming, slaughtering, and meat processing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced breeding technologies including a proprietary two-way crossbreeding system and genetic evaluation. It uses intelligent farming technologies such as smart ventilation, feeding, and environmental control systems. Feed production incorporates optimized nutrition formulas and low-soybean meal diets to reduce costs and environmental impact. The slaughtering and meat processing utilize automated and intelligent equipment to ensure product quality and safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Muyuan serves a broad customer base including institutional buyers and individual customers across China. Its products include commercial pigs, piglets, breeding pigs, and processed pork products. The company targets domestic markets primarily, supplying fresh and frozen pork products to retail, wholesale, and food service sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China with pig farming facilities in 24 provinces and slaughterhouses in 20 provinces. It has over 300 subsidiaries nationwide, reflecting a wide geographic footprint focused on major pig farming regions in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Muyuan operates a vertically integrated supply chain covering upstream feed production and breeding, midstream pig farming, and downstream slaughtering and meat processing. This integration allows control over quality, costs, and biosecurity throughout the entire pork production value chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in breeding, nutrition, disease prevention, and intelligent farming technologies. R&D projects focus on optimizing pig nutrition, health management, carcass quality, and automation of feeding and environmental control. It also invests in green and low-carbon farming technologies, including waste recycling and renewable energy. The company aims to enhance production efficiency, reduce costs, and improve product quality through continuous technological advancement.
categories.revenue_model: Muyuan generates revenue primarily through the sale of live pigs (commercial, breeding, and piglets) and processed pork products. Revenue is recognized when control of goods transfers to customers, typically upon delivery or customer acceptance. The company also earns income from feed raw material sales and other ancillary businesses.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Muyuan is one of the leading pig farming and pork processing companies in China, with a significant market share in a fragmented industry. It competes with other large-scale integrated pig producers and slaughterhouses. The company emphasizes its vertical integration, scale, technological innovation, and food safety controls to maintain a competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Muyuan achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 137.95 billion, a 24.43% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 18.9 billion, a significant turnaround from losses in prior years. The company sold over 71.6 million pigs and slaughtered 12.5 million pigs, demonstrating strong growth and scale. It maintains substantial assets including fixed assets over RMB 106 billion and a large network of subsidiaries.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Muyuan offers high-quality, safe, and traceable pork products through its fully integrated supply chain and stringent food safety management systems. Its proprietary breeding and nutrition technologies improve meat quality and production efficiency. The company leverages intelligent farming and automation to reduce costs and enhance animal welfare. It also commits to sustainable and green farming practices, aligning with consumer demand for environmentally friendly and healthy food.
